verdict: $622 spent, 131 clicks, zero leads recorded — tracking is being fixed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads campaigns drew 131 clicks and 654 website sessions, but zero leads were recorded — conversion tracking is confirmed broken, meaning real enquiries are not registering, not that demand has disappeared. Ad spend pulled back 28% in the most recent week, a sensible response while the tracking issue is under repair. Conversion tracking is being rebuilt now, with offline conversion import and full end-to-end stack testing both due by end of September. Once tracking is restored, you will have an accurate read on cost per lead and we can scale spend with confidence.
